title: Pin runtime-exit pause retention and completed-wake exclusions with regression controls
outcome: Regression controls distinguish factual unfinished-wake settlement from already completed exact-WAL bookkeeping under a pause, and pin intentional operator-pause retention for an exiting non-wake Engram session.
acceptance: A paused Error session whose exact wake WAL already completed remains free of a new wake failure, notice, replay or provider enqueue when the current runtime exit is applied; a paired unfinished wake control still retains its Accepted/Unknown failure.
A non-wake Engram session with an independent operator pause retains that pause across its exact runtime exit, with ordinary unpaused exit behavior covered as a positive control.
